reason: A small startup asking for read access to our Microsoft 365 and ERP, with student data flowing into a phone app, is not something I can push through committee in a month. I might discuss the free pilot, but I am not committing ₹9 lakh a year on a pitch.
objection: What exactly they read from our tenant and ERP, where student data is stored, and who is liable if a small Hyderabad team gets breached. A DPDP agreement on paper does not tell me their security is real.
would_change_my_mind: A security review I can verify: least-privilege read-only M365 permissions documented, data hosted in India, a third-party audit or pen-test report, and a reference from another university already running it.
